title: Shifted localized free complexes are coproducts of shifted generators
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring in universe $u$, assume the derived category of $R$-modules with carriers in universe $\max(u,v)$ exists [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $T$ be a cochain complex of these modules. Suppose $I$ is a set in universe $\max(u,v)$, $d:I\to\mathbb Z$, and $T\cong\bigoplus_{i\in I}(\operatorname{ULift}R)[-d_i]$ as complexes, with summand $i$ supported in degree $d_i$. Then there are integers $e_i$ and maps $j_i:(R[0])[e_i]\to Q(T)[-1]$ presenting $Q(T)[-1]$ as their coproduct. The free rank-one module $R$ here has carrier $\operatorname{ULift}R$ in the stated module universe.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-derived-module-direct-sums] to the family of single complexes supported in degrees d_i. It gives a coproduct cocone at Q of their complex coproduct.

Shift the coproduct cocone by -1; this functor is an equivalence, so isColimitOfPreserves gives a colimit cocone. Transport the cocone point by the shifted image under Q of the given isomorphism T≅coproduct.

Set e_i=-d_i-1. The singleFunctors.shiftIso with n=-d_i, a=d_i, a′=0 identifies the shift by -d_i of singleFunctor 0 with singleFunctor d_i. The shiftFunctorAdd comparison then identifies its further shift by -1 with the shift by e_i. Precompose the coprojections with these isomorphisms. Construct desc by composing with the inverse point isomorphism and the old coproduct desc; the factorization and uniqueness identities follow from the old coproduct universal property and cancellation of isomorphisms.

theorem derivedShiftedFreeCoproduct (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)]
    (T : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ)
    (I : Type (max u v)) (degree : I → ℤ)
    (hT : Nonempty (T ≅ ∐ (fun i : I =>
      (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (degree i)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} R))))) :
    ∃ (d : I → ℤ)
      (j : ∀ i : I, (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} R)))⟦d i⟧) ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T)⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj T)⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧) j))
